summary: Your asset list is cleaner, with fewer duplicate machines, and you choose what goes to ServiceNow.

new.title: Choose which assets go to ServiceNow
new.text: You can limit the items sent to ServiceNow by asset type and operating system, for example keeping mobile phones out while Windows, Linux and Azure resources go.

new.title: Decide on probable duplicate devices
new.text: A data-quality check lists devices that are probably the same machine. You decide "same machine" or "not the same", and the next build uses your decision.

new.title: Retire proven-deleted assets at once
new.text: An asset proven deleted can now be retired at once instead of after 30 days, with its open findings closed. One switch per source, all off by default.

new.title: Leave out stale accounts and groups
new.text: You can choose to leave out disabled Active Directory accounts that never synced, and groups no longer in Entra ID. Both are off by default; privileged accounts are always kept.

new.title: Smaller improvements
new.text: The CI list's lifecycle filter is in both filter panels.

fixes.title: One CI per domain-joined computer
fixes.text: A computer's Active Directory account is no longer a second device beside the machine itself. It is linked to the device it belongs to.

fixes.title: Placeholder device names no longer join devices
fixes.text: A device with a placeholder name takes its name from another source or a clear generated name. A placeholder name never joins two devices.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The ServiceNow check counts items without a database error, page texts name menu paths the same way, and the updater keeps its timers in step.
